author: NewVoltdrive
body:
So, here are some CTH problems I've noticed.

If you are a Demo, and the game is just about to end, if you place your TNT down, and it blows up after the game is over, it blows a hole in the floor.

Remember when they nerfed Ninja by making it so you can't take off armor? Can we do that again please?

Donors don't get an XP boost. Not sure if that is a serverwide issue, but it is happening in CTH.

That's it for now. I will list more when I have found more.
